text.p: Lehman Brothers revised its 1997 earnings per share estimate for Scitex Corp, saying the Israeli company is now expected to post a smaller than expected loss.
The revision follows last week's announcement of a $0.17 a share loss in the first quarter, smaller than the $0.34 a share loss forecast by Lehman.
In a report released on Monday, Lehman analyst Ted Kundtz cited a significant improvement in the company's graphic arts division from very depressed fourth-quarter levels.
"The company as a whole should become modestly profitable in the September quarter," the report said.
Lehman's revised estimate calls for a 1997 loss of $0.09 a share versus an earlier estimate of a $0.26 loss and last year's loss of $4.16.
Lehman maintained its 2-Outperform rating as a "long-term value and turnaround play".
Scitex makes computer imaging systems used in the printing and publishing industries as well as digital printing and digital video editing systems.
